summary: Corporación Inmobiliaria Vesta, S.A.B. de C.V. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a global offering of 70,047,634 common shares (including ADSs). This is a routine seasoned equity offering, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven catalyst is involved. The filing describes a coordinated international and Mexican public offering with an over-allotment option, but no special-situation triggers such as a change of control, tender, or delisting.
